comment: Products a player may claim once for free, by the id the client's special items window asks for (external_variables special_items.<key>.free_claim). Each hands over the furniture listed, by class name. The chests window offers the starter Furni Chest, which its text says 'can be claimed for free in this window'. A claim may also offer choices, one of which the player takes, each furniture with the badge that comes with it: the cursed dragon adoption (October 2026, its texts: "You can adopt only one dragon from this offer"), 0 blue and 1 purple, each a box with its dragon (as habbo.com hands it over) and the badge PET17 or PET18 ("I adopted a Blue/Purple Cursed Dragon!").
